newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Gdansk issues second tranche of muni bonds.
newsitem.headline: Polish Gdansk issues second tranche of muni bonds.

text.p: Poland's city of Gdansk issued 18.8 million zlotys worth of five-year floating municipal bonds on June 5, the city's deputy president said.
Longin Mazewski told a news conference the issue was the second tranche of its 99.3 million zloty municipal bonds programme started in December 1996.
He said the city would issue another 29.8 million zlotys worth of bonds this year and 39.2 million zlotys of the paper in 1998. @
The city's whole municipal bond plan, run by Bank Handlowy, Bank Gdanski and Merrill Lynch, is to provide funds for transport and infrastructure.
The bonds carry an annual coupon of 105 basis points above the average yield of 52-week T-bills auctioned at two primary auctions preceding the issue.
